description: Identity of the model that interprets anomalies, and the labels the UI shows for it. Feedback round-01 F4 asks for explicit attribution on agent output; Q3 asks that the version string come from the configured model rather than being hardcoded in a component. This file is that single source.

model.verification_note: Q3 is unresolved: the walkthrough said 'Gemma 4', which is not a model that has been confirmed here, and no inference call is wired up yet. Until a real client sets this from the model it actually calls, the UI shows the name greyed with an 'unverified' marker rather than asserting a version it cannot back up. Set verified to true once a call site reports this id.

producers.description: What generates each alert tier (docs/alert-system.md). The alerts panel groups by these, so a viewer can tell model-generated reasoning from a static rule firing — feedback round-01 F5.

2b.label: Signal detection
2b.detail: Pattern match over a rolling window

2c.label: TimesFM + Gemma
2c.detail: TimesFM flags the deviation, Gemma interprets it

interpretation.description: How long Gemma is shown as thinking before its interpretation appears. docs/alert-system.md puts the real interpret step at 2-5 s; the simulator holds the same window so the in-progress state is visible rather than instantaneous.
